mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, John Ehlers' four-element Laguerre RSI returning inside its conventional 0.2/0.8 envelope on completed four-hour BTC auctions marks a fast one-sided close-price excursion beginning to normalize; when the completed four-hour BTC perpetual premium displacement agrees with that re-entry side, follow the sponsored re-entry direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when Laguerre RSI crosses strictly above 0.2 after being at or below 0.2; short when it crosses strictly below 0.8 after being at or above 0.8
mechanism.why_distinct: The oscillator recursively warps close-price time through four Laguerre states before accumulating ordered state differences. HVELRSIPSC adds only exact decision-available same-block BTC perpetual premium displacement concordance; it does not use a fixed rolling close-return window, range location, high/low expansion, volume, OI, flow, funding, fitted outcomes, prior events, or a promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%, while same-direction premium displacement identifies derivative sponsorship
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: the conjunction of sparse Laguerre-state re-entry and same-block premium displacement concordance is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.laguerre_initialization: after an invalid gap initialize L0=L1=L2=L3 to the first valid completed bar close; that bar has zero denominator and no oscillator value
features.laguerre_rsi: causal four-state Ehlers recursion at gamma 0.5, then CU/(CU+CD), invalid at zero denominator
features.reentry: current ratio strictly crosses inward through 0.2 or 0.8 from immediately prior valid ratio
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.premium_block: 240 exact unique coherent BTCUSDT bars_binance_premium interval=1m rows [T-4h,T); finite signed OHLC
features.premium_displacement: last completed premium close minus first completed premium open; strict nonzero
features.premium_sponsorship: sign(premium_displacement) equals the frozen Laguerre RSI re-entry side

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: published Ehlers Laguerre RSI re-entry with causal premium displacement sponsorship

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no gamma, initialization, recursion, level, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.origin: John F. Ehlers, Time Warp—Without Space Travel / Cybernetic Analysis for Stocks and Futures
external_basis.fixed_definition: close input; gamma 0.5; L0=(1-gamma)*close+gamma*prior L0; L1=-gamma*L0+prior L0+gamma*prior L1, repeated through L3; CU and CD sum the positive and negative ordered differences L0-L1, L1-L2, L2-L3; ratio CU/(CU+CD); conventional 0.2/0.8 envelope
external_basis.selection_use: published input, gamma, recursion, ratio, levels, and direction only; no incidence or outcomes
